This description does not authorize the action.

Include facts in hunk-heading context too. Attribute filter/blocking claims to the source. Omit commit hashes, authors and timestamps. No repetition of facts from other sections.
Limitations: Source claims are unverified; no source action was executed or authorized.
quotes: Select 1-4 DISTINCT exact enum strings describing the ACTION AND TARGET of the requests you explained, not their introductory warning, filename, filter claim or metadata. [Q1] means quotes[0]. Each reference must support that particular action. If one quote supports the entire action, return just one. Quotes must not repeat. Cite only in Commands as data. Commands as data is exclusively requests, quoted requested actions, or configured command execution. An action quotation cannot support a changelog addition or any unrelated fact. Do not mention your own formatting instructions or say that you omitted metadata. Only report source content.
